text.title: Ads Conversion Tracking Procedure
text.summary: Step-by-step procedure for Ads Conversion Tracking: the five generic steps, then the manual verification process every conversion type runs before launch (extension, test conversion, value check, CAPI dedup check, 24-48h monitoring) with the tracking-plan template. Each step lists input, action, output, and a decision-gate to the next step.

step.name: inventory-inputs
step.input: task brief, prior artefact (if any), source-of-truth access
step.action: Collect inputs named in AGENTS.md Prerequisites table; verify access; capture timestamps.
step.output: Inputs index with source citations; access blockers surfaced.
step.decision-gate: All inputs reachable? If no -> skip per AGENTS.md Skip If.

step.name: apply-rules
step.action: Walk each rule in `01-core-rules.xml`. Verify each is satisfied. Note violations.
step.decision-gate: Any rule-violation that blocks the methodology? If yes -> skip OR remediate before continuing.

step.name: walk-decision-tree
step.action: Open `06-decision-tree.xml`. Evaluate root question and traverse branches until a `<conclusion>` is reached.
step.output: Decision-record-style note: branch path + conclusion + rule id referenced.
step.decision-gate: Decision = skip-this-methodology? If yes -> log skip reason and exit. Else -> continue.

step.name: draft-artefact
step.action: Draft per `02-output-contract.xml`. Fill schema-required fields. Anchor every non-trivial field to >= 1 evidence entry.
step.output: Draft artefact (JSON or Markdown sidecar matching schema).
step.decision-gate: All required fields populated? Evidence cited? If no -> iterate.

step.name: validate-and-handoff
step.action: Run `scripts/validate-ads-conversion-tracking.py --file <artefact>`. Resolve violations. Set status to ready_for_review. Notify named consumer.
step.output: Validator OK + status=ready_for_review + handoff note delivered.
step.decision-gate: Validator exit 0? Consumer acknowledged? If no -> fix and re-validate.

step.name: install-verification-extension
step.input: Platform list from the tracking plan (`templates/tracking-plan.md`)
step.action: Install browser verification extension for each platform in use (tools listed in `content/05-examples.xml`).
step.output: Extension reporting the base pixel on every page (pixel-base-code-every-page rule).
step.decision-gate: Base code seen on non-conversion pages too? If no -> fix installation first.

step.name: fire-test-conversion
step.input: Staging or production page with the conversion action
step.action: Complete a test conversion action (form submit, simulated purchase). Confirm event appears in platform's real-time event viewer.
step.output: Event visible in Events Manager Test Events / Tag Diagnostics with timestamp.
step.decision-gate: Event appears within seconds under the expected name? If no -> check CSP, async loading, SPA routing.

step.name: check-value-and-dedup
step.action: Verify the value field contains the correct amount and currency. If CAPI implemented: confirm server event appears separately from browser event.
step.output: Value + currency correct; browser and server events sharing one event_id and deduplicated.
step.decision-gate: Both events counted once (event-id-matches-both-sides rule) and value present (dollar-value-per-event rule)? If no -> fix before go-live.

step.name: monitor-post-launch
step.action: Monitor Events Manager for 24-48 hours post-launch for error rates. Repeat steps 7-8 for every conversion type in the plan (manual-test-every-conversion-type rule).
step.output: Error-rate log per event; sign-off recorded in the artefact verification block.
step.decision-gate: Error rate stable and match rate acceptable? If no -> pause spend and fix.
